title: Microservices and CI/CD
description: Growing the Compose stack into two services and automating it: monolith versus microservices with a database per service, adding the FastAPI service and its database, service-to-service calls with tokens, timeouts and failed downstream calls, SQL versus NoSQL, API gateways and service discovery, a GitHub Actions pipeline that tests and then builds images, secrets in CI, and an optional reading on Jenkins, registries, CD and Kubernetes.
sourceCoverageNotes: This module covers S38 rows 0-3 and S39 rows 0-2 (Fast FT22 rows 1-4 and FT23 rows 0-2).
S39 row 3 and FT23 row 3 'Containers and CI/CD module check' map to the course assessment blueprint containers-cicd/assessments/containers-cicd-module-check, not to a learner topic.

S38 row 3 'Reading: SQL vs NoSQL, API gateways and service discovery' and its Fast variant (FT22 row 4, skim) are split into sql-vs-nosql (data-store choice) and api-gateways-and-service-discovery (routing and discovery), so each page builds one model (intake reconciliation education-01); the frozen row is unchanged. The S39 optional Reading keeps its optional status as track metadata.

Planned module coding lab containers-cicd/microservices-and-ci-cd/coding-lab (Standard S38-S39 lab overlay; Fast does not require it) is authored in this module's PR; moduleLabs lists it once it exists. See authoring/evidence/containers-cicd/intake.md, section Lab plan.

Fast project (captain decision pep-fast-project-block, option A): Fast days FT22 and FT23 apply this module's topics in increments 2 and 3 of the cumulative Containers & CI/CD Fast project, planned at containers-cicd/coding-lab/ and presented as a project increment, not a coding lab. It reuses this module lab's scaffold and rule checks. See authoring/evidence/containers-cicd/intake.md, section Fast project increments.
